meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织好画面轨道与子合成,让项目如期渲染
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做动画合成,想一次写对项目结构避免返工
copy.tagline_en: Organize tracks and sub-compositions to make your project render reliably
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're creating animated compositions and want to get the structure right without rework

howto.what: 这个技能提供 HyperFrames 的技术规范:编写 composition HTML 时需用 data-* 属性控制时间,用 class="clip" 标记片段,支持子组合、变量和框架管理的媒体播放,并遵守确定性渲染规则与校验流程。它还涵盖 Tailwind 项目和 STORYBOARD.md/SCRIPT.md 计划格式。
howto.when: 当你要编写 HyperFrames 的 composition HTML,或处理时间属性、子组合、媒体播放等规范时触发。

say.text: 检查这个 composition 里有没有违反确定性渲染的写法。
say.note: 会找无种子随机、repeat:-1 等禁止模式。

say.text: 给这个子组合设置 data-composition-id,并统一模板内的 id。
say.note: 确保宿主、模板和 timeline 键一致。

howto.what_en: The HyperFrames technical contract: composition HTML with data-* timing, class="clip", sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media, deterministic rendering, validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and STORYBOARD/SCRIPT plans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing HyperFrames composition HTML or handling timing attributes, sub-compositions, media playback, and other specs.

say_en.text: Write me a minimal HyperFrames composition HTML skeleton.
say_en.note: Generates a root with data-composition-id and a paused timeline.

say_en.text: Check this composition for deterministic-render violations.
say_en.note: Looks for unseeded random, repeat:-1, and other banned patterns.

say_en.text: Set the data-composition-id for this sub-composition and unify ids inside the template.
say_en.note: Aligns host, template, and timeline key.
